pseudocode: trendLineBrokenWithin(lookbackBars) && close[0] < open[0] && (open[0] - close[0]) >= bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0]) && high[0] >= swingHigh(1) - touchTolAtr * atr(atrLength)
book_order_type: sell stop below the reversal bar (mechanized: next bar open)

complexity.reason: needs the trend-line break state plus the swing-pivot reference

name: PriorTrendLineBreakRequired
quote: All trends, no matter how small, must first break a trend line from the prior trend or a support or resistance line from a prior trading range, and then have trending swings

name: RepeatedTrendLineTestsBreakThrough
quote: Whenever the market repeatedly tests a line and does not fall far from it, the market usually breaks above it.
